title: Acute right lower quadrant pain
presentation: A 24-year-old man presents with 18 hours of periumbilical pain that migrated to the right lower quadrant, with nausea and loss of appetite.

findings.value: Periumbilical pain migrating to the right lower quadrant
Tenderness at McBurney's point with rebound

title: Sudden pleuritic chest pain after a long flight
presentation: A 41-year-old woman on combined oral contraceptives develops sudden pleuritic chest pain and dyspnea two days after a 12-hour flight.

findings.value: Heart rate 118/min, SpO2 91% on room air
CT pulmonary angiography: filling defect in the right lower lobe artery
